spec.name: M8.Cutoff.limit_bounds
spec.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, M8.Cutoff.limit N ≤ N-1 ∧ M8.Cutoff.limit N ≤ Nat.log 2 (N+1) ∧ (0 < N → M8.Cutoff.limit N < N)
spec.guidance: Unfold limit; min_le_left/right, Nat.sub_lt for positive N. Includes N=1 cutoff0 and total N=0 definition, no higher-span assumption. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.bit_length_limit
spec.guidance: Unfold limit and use Nat.log2_eq_log_two. This is the exact integer bit-length/logarithm interface. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.state_bound
spec.statement: ∀ (N R : ℕ), R ≤ M8.Cutoff.limit N → 2^R ≤ N+1
spec.guidance: Use Nat.le_log_iff_pow_le with base2 and nonzero N+1, or pow monotonicity and Nat.pow_log_le_self. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.state_square
spec.guidance: Rewrite 4^R=(2^R)^2 using pow_mul and bound the square of state_bound. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.indexed_work_envelopes
spec.guidance: Multiply accepted state_square by N^3/N^4, bound N by N+1, and normalize powers. These bound existing M6 work expressions; they are not new cost definitions. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.indexed_storage_envelope
spec.statement: ∀ (N R : ℕ), R ≤ M8.Cutoff.limit N → N^2 * 2^R ≤ (N+1)^3
spec.guidance: Multiply state_bound by N^2≤(N+1)^2 and normalize powers. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.coefficient_capacity
spec.guidance: Rewrite 8=2^3 and product powers as 2^(R+3*N). limit_bounds implies R≤N. Strict exponent bound follows by omega; apply pow_lt_pow_right for base2. This bounds the actual coefficient envelope, including signed intermediate magnitudes. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.

metadata.source_section: Revised M8 §7 fixed logarithmic cutoff resource arithmetic

spec.name: M8.Cutoff.anchor_trial_envelope
spec.statement: ∀ (N a b : ℕ), a ≤ N → b ≤ N → 2*N*a*b ≤ 2*N^3
spec.guidance: Natural multiplication monotonicity and ring normalization. Root must independently identify actual anchor trials with <=2*N*|A|*|B|; this helper alone is not a discovery-cost proof. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.
